resource_load.note: 3 DB queries: get team, check team_repo, load team_units
Multiple DB ops in transaction: check, insert, update, recalculate access, auto-watch

performance_issues.description: Auto-watch iterates over team members and calls WatchRepo individually
performance_issues.impact: For large teams, N+1 inserts into watch table
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch insert watches for all team members

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch watch insertions for team members
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce N individual inserts to 1 batch insert for large teams
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use a bulk insert for watch records instead of iterating

resource_load.note: Multiple DB ops: check, get repo, delete, update, recalculate, check access per member, remove watches

performance_issues.description: Iterates over team members checking HasAnyUnitAccess and removing watches individually
performance_issues.impact: For large teams, N queries to check access + N deletes for watches
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch check access for all members, then batch remove watches

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch access check and watch removal for team members
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce 2N queries to 2 batch queries for large teams
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Query all member access in one query, then batch delete watches

resource_load.note: Find forks + load owners + load units + N permission checks

performance_issues.description: GetDoerRepoPermission called in a loop for each fork
performance_issues.impact: N additional queries for N forks returned
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch load permissions for all forks at once

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch permission loading for fork list
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce N permission queries to 1 batch query

resource_load.note: Heavy operation: DB inserts + git clone + branch/tag sync

performance_issues.description: Git clone operation blocks the request thread with 10-minute timeout
performance_issues.impact: Large repos can block for minutes; ties up a goroutine
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider async fork creation with status polling (already returns 202)

optimization_recommendations.description: Fork creation could be fully async since it already returns 202
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Free up request goroutine immediately for large repos
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Queue fork creation as background job, return 202 with status URL

resource_load.note: Get issue + LoadAttributes (loads many relations) + convert

performance_issues.description: LoadAttributes loads all issue relations (labels, assignees, etc.) when only labels are needed
performance_issues.impact: Extra unnecessary queries for poster, milestone, assignees, attachments
performance_issues.recommendation: Use issue.LoadLabels(ctx) instead of LoadAttributes to load only labels

optimization_recommendations.description: Load only labels instead of all attributes
